latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle Editor — 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI-powered subtitle editing directly from video upload to 1080p export in under 60 seconds.
- Automates session and token management, with support for anonymous usage (100 free credits).
- Converts plain instructions or file uploads into cloud-rendered videos with captions in multiple languages (e.g., English and Spanish).
- No timeline editing or manual export steps needed—just describe the result and receive a ready-to-download link.
- Supports a wide range of formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Built-in workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement, with user-friendly feedback and error handling.
